{{Quote|Someone has to do the dirty work. If I can get these sorry louts the opportunity to do one good thing for society, then it's worth it.|Rusk, on why he puts up with the Dead Man's Legion|<ref name="Bonds" />}}
The '''Dead Man's Legion''', also referred to as the '''Dead Men''', was a unit of criminals who were forcibly conscripted into the [[Republic Army]] during the years after the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Provost Marshal]] [[Fideltin Rusk]] was in command of the unit, and they were deployed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to hunt down the members of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] who evaded the unit's campaign on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The unit had a reputation of being dangerous and unruly but got results.<ref name="Bonds" />
